mapper.select: SELECT hour.*, ssp.name_alise AS sspName, app.name AS appName, app.os_type AS osType, media.media_company_short AS mediaName FROM data_ssp_slot_hour AS hour LEFT JOIN ssp_slot_info AS ssp ON hour.ssp_slot_id = ssp.id LEFT JOIN ssp_app AS app ON app.id = ssp.app_id LEFT JOIN ssp_media AS media ON media.id = ssp.media_id WHERE hour.dsp_slot_id = #{dspSlotId} AND hour.date = #{date} ORDER BY hour.id DESC
